full_prompt_en: A square, richly textured narrative painting portrays a mustached man from the chest up before a golden wall of ancient-looking reliefs. He faces three-quarters toward the right, his visible eye looking along the edge of the frame. A wide brown brim crosses the upper middle of the picture and shades his forehead. Above it rises a decorative bird with outstretched turquoise and ocher wings, its head and slender beak turned to the right. A dark geometric shape behind the bird adds height to the hat ornament. The man's warm brown face is modeled with small strokes and patches of shadow, leaving the ear, cheekbone, and straight mouth clearly formed. A dark teal bird-beak mask or attached ornament projects across the bridge of his nose, extending well beyond the face. Its painted eye and curved hooked tip echo the bird on the hat, making the unusual headgear the central visual accent. Below, a pale sand-colored jacket with broad lapels opens over a white shirt, dark patterned tie, and layered warm and turquoise neck decoration. The background is covered edge to edge with rectangular bands, carved figures, and small pictorial marks in honey, ocher, and umber. Their exact symbols remain too small to read, but incised dark lines and repeated borders give the wall a dense, aged surface. Fine grain and uneven pigment tie the figure to that warm textured ground, while stronger dark outlines around the hat, mask, and shoulder keep him distinct. Light falls from the upper left, warming the face and jacket and catching the raised wall pattern; the underside of the brim and right side of the head remain darker. The overall composition is dense and frontal in scale, joining a restrained portrait with ornate gilded pattern and a striking turquoise bird motif.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、肌理浓厚的叙事绘画描绘一名留小胡子的男子，画面取到胸部，背后是布满古老样式浮雕的金色墙面。他以四分之三侧身朝右，可见的一只眼沿画面边缘方向望去。宽阔的棕色帽檐横过上部中央，遮住额头。帽上立着一只装饰性的鸟，青绿与赭黄翅膀张开，头和细喙朝右。鸟后一个深色几何形体增加了帽饰的高度。男子的暖褐色面孔由细小笔迹与斑驳阴影塑出，耳朵、颧骨和紧闭的嘴形都清晰可辨。一件深青绿色鸟喙面具或附着的装饰物横跨鼻梁，远远伸出脸外。它画出的眼睛和弯钩形尖端呼应帽上的鸟，让不同寻常的头饰成为中央视觉重音。下方，浅沙色外套的宽翻领敞开，露出白衬衫、深色纹样领带以及暖色与青绿色交织的颈部装饰。背景从边到边铺满矩形分带、雕刻人物和细小图形符号，色彩在蜜黄、赭黄与深棕间变化。符号太小，无法逐字辨认，但刻入的深线和重复的边框使墙面显得密集而陈旧。细微颗粒和不均匀颜料把人物与这片暖色肌理底面连在一起，帽子、面具和肩部周围较重的深色轮廓则让他保持分明。光从左上方照下，暖化面孔与外套，也抓住墙面隆起的纹样；帽檐下方和头部右侧保持较暗。整体构图尺度紧凑且正面迫近，把克制肖像、华丽的金色纹样和醒目的青绿色鸟类形态结合起来。
style_prompt_en: The narrative painting combines finely modeled volume with a dense, aged ornamental ground. Honey gold, ocher, sand, and deep umber form a closely related warm field, interrupted by smaller turquoise and dark teal accents that immediately draw the eye. Repeated rectangular divisions, incised-looking lines, and miniature pictorial marks make the background active without giving it deep perspective. Larger foreground shapes retain clear contours and rounded light-dark modeling, so they stand apart from the tighter graphic pattern. Brush grain, mottled pigment, and softly worn edges create an antique material feel; selective dark lines sharpen key overlaps. Directional warm light catches raised-looking details and exposed planes, while shaded recesses stay brown rather than black. A large central mass against compact repeated marks creates a strong scale contrast. The overall effect is intricate and theatrical, with ornate surface rhythm balanced by solid, legible form.
style_prompt_zh: 这种叙事绘画把细致塑形的体积与密集、陈旧的装饰底面结合起来。蜜金、赭黄、沙色和深棕形成相近的暖色域，少量青绿与深青色重音从中跳出，立即吸引视线。重复的矩形分割、近似刻划的线条和微小图形痕迹让背景活跃，却不赋予它很深的透视。较大的前景形状保留清楚轮廓和圆润的明暗塑形，因此与紧密的图形纹样拉开距离。笔触颗粒、斑驳颜料与轻微磨旧的边缘形成古旧材料感；选择性的深线则强化关键叠压。定向暖光抓住看似隆起的细节和外露体面，阴影凹处保持褐色而非纯黑。宽大的中央体块与紧凑反复的细痕形成鲜明尺度对比。整体效果复杂而有戏剧性，以华丽的表面节奏平衡坚实、可辨的形体。
theme_en: An explorer in a bird-adorned hat and beak mask before a gilded carved wall
theme_zh: 一位戴鸟饰帽和鸟喙面具的探险者立于金色雕刻墙前
name: Howard Carter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
